mechanism: Quinidine inhibits CYP3A4, the primary metabolic pathway of eplerenone, leading to increased eplerenone plasma concentrations and enhanced potassium-sparing effects with additive cardiac effects.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider eplerenone dose reduction or use alternative antiarrhythmic if possible; avoid concurrent use if feasible due to combined risks of hyperkalemia and QT prolongation.
